InferenceRule.description:
Preregistered paired inference; cases are the independent unit, seeds are nested.

Each case contributes its mean paired score difference across the registered seeds.
The interval is a percentile bootstrap over cases at confidence ``1 - alpha``; the
p-value is an exact two-sided sign test on the nonzero case differences. A candidate
is supported only when its target effect is superior to the original AND to every
registered control and comparator (an intersection-union test, so the joint claim
keeps level ``alpha``), and its regression-case effect against the original is
non-inferior within ``regression_margin``. Fewer than six cases per role cannot reach
significance and are refused at admission.
InferenceRule.title: InferenceRule

PortableBase.description:
What a shared artifact pins: exact checkpoint bytes at a load dtype, never a machine.

``ModelIdentity.fingerprint`` also hashes the device, driver and library versions, so
it identifies one runtime. Evidence pins that fingerprint. Anything meant to travel
between machines pins this record instead, and is bound to the local runtime only
after the loaded weights digest has been verified.
PortableBase.title: PortableBase

RecipeSpec.description:
A re-runnable derivation; coordinates expire with a checkpoint, recipes do not.

``positive`` prompts exhibit the behaviour and ``negative`` prompts do not. Even
positions of each list fit a direction and odd positions score it, so the site is
never chosen on the data that produced its direction.
RecipeSpec.title: RecipeSpec
